column3: Close to the Hebrew; the Hebrew “he will groan” (or “one will groan”) is rendered “I will mourn.”
NKJV renders “more than the weeping of Jazer” as “with the weeping of Jazer,” and “your tendrils” as “Your plants.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the garden-land” is rendered “the plentiful field.”
Close to the Hebrew; the place name “Eglath Shelishiyah” is rendered as a phrase, “Like a three-year-old heifer.”
Close to the Hebrew; “it will groan” is rendered “shall wail.”
Close to the Hebrew; “all of it wailing” is rendered “A general lamentation.”
Close to the Hebrew; “it has turned the neck … it will be ashamed” is rendered “has turned her back with shame,” and “an object of terror” “a dismay.”
Close to the Hebrew; “seized” is rendered “surprised.”
Close to the Hebrew; “from strength” is rendered “Because of exhaustion.”
Close to the Hebrew; the future “they will be taken” is rendered “have been taken.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I will turn back the captivity” is rendered “I will bring back the captives.”
